notes.title: Why Albatross is so bad
notes.content: With everyone bringing it to my attention of how bad it is i do have to remind you this was a [b]testing project[/b] purely to see what i was and wasn't capable of. I worked on this alone and i am a [b]self taught 17 year old[/b]. All I am asking for is don't use this for reference when you see the name Qureo on other games. We have better projects. Mental state hasn't been great due to recent events. I know you guys are expecting good things in games I'm that way too, but look at the description and background of game developers. Offer support, give reviews, even kind words help. I'm sorry for the way this was released. Updates will be discontinued after this year
